description: Diagnostic module to analyze why permission_scope_enrichment.py produces only 4 distinct scores. Reads metadata fields (registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars, tool_count, permission_flags) and simulates compute_score() across synthetic corpus. Outputs a report of score distribution and identifies which input field dominates the output. Do NOT modify the enrichment module directly; output findings as a diagnostic report consumable by the directive generator for follow-on enrichment improvements. Reference: spec section 3 signal invariant, section 10 directive generator rules.
